text: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.
The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms.
Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, and wept sore.
Man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.
In my distress I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple.
I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you.
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at last he will stand upon the earth.
But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come out like gold.
Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed, a high tower in times of trouble.
LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear.
How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice.
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
The LORD is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness.
Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye is consumed with grief. Yes, my soul and my body.
I said in my haste, ‘I am cut off from before your eyes.’ Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He also brought me up out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay.
My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, ‘Where is your God?’
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I will still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song will be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Be still, and know that I am God.
My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me.
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you.
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck. I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold.
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, will let me live. You will bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
My voice is to God, and I will cry out; my voice is to God, and he will hear me. In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord.
In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you. Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
Hear my prayer, LORD. Let my cry come to you. Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress.
Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the name of the LORD.
Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word. My eyes fail for your word. I say, ‘When will you comfort me?’
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD. Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me.
I pour out my complaint before him. I tell my trouble before him. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my way.
Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you.
The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares its joy.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.
He has swallowed up death forever; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces.
Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom.
But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you.
He was despised, and rejected by men; a man of suffering, and acquainted with grief.
Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering.
My loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed, says the LORD who has compassion on you.
I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble.
The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me; because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted.
To give to them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you.
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
For I have satiated the weary soul, and every sorrowful soul have I replenished.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
Come, and let us return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
The LORD your God is in the midst of you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted.
Jesus wept.
Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you... Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
...nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Blessed be... the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed.
Therefore we don’t faint; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more.
